title: A life to get back to
notes: All A Diary for Timothy shots are GRADE-BW and allowed to run; Dunkirk is FILM-43 + GRADE-BW.
14-01 is the later half of the same ward track scene 12 uses (12-03 at 224.5): here the camera travels down the beds to the young patient, 240–245. It answers 'Other people did'.

Plan's 'Diary ≈15:00, the nurse walking the patient' is the shot scene 11 closes on (11-14, 884.3–897.4). Not repeated here three minutes later; 'every day after that, other people made it work' goes on the nurse serving tea to the patients (≈08:00, shot #51), which is also the plan's 14:25 '→ ≈08:00'. If Kai wants the deliberate echo, swap 14-02 for 11-14's shot at the same clock.

Dunkirk: scene 01 is not written yet. The plan's '05:08–05:20 troops disembarking' block is ten very short shots; used here: #44 (troops embracing on the quay, 313.2) and #46 (British troops walking off, grinning, thumbs up, past an ambulance, 317.5). Whichever of these scene 01 ends on, 14-03/14-04 should match it.

Ending: the baby in his cot (Timothy), the film's last shot before its own fade and 'THE END' card (≈2222.5). Our fade to black runs over the last 3 s of 14-05 (885–888), then 2 s of pure black (888–890): the film has ended. The FADE treatment in premiere-plan.py is 12 frames: set it to 3 s (75 frames) by hand on the tail of 14-05.
Credit for A Diary for Timothy still owed (see 11).
